description: This file implements a REST API for a personal journal management application using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for CRUD operations on journal entries, with support for JSON and multipart form data uploads, image handling, and date filtering. It initializes database connections, manages static file serving for uploaded images, and provides internal verification endpoints.
